query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM file f
            WHERE f.arrangement_id = $1
              AND f.voice_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2
              AND f.name = $3
              AND f.format = $4
              AND f.id <> $5
              AND f.created_at > (SELECT created_at FROM file WHERE id = $5)
        ) AS "superseded!"
